answer_1.quote: A built-in communication mechanism enables text message exchange among agents per round.
answer_1.outputs: natural language messages and action choices

answer_2.quote: Team performance is measured using two metrics: the team score, indicating coordination quality, and rounds to completion, measuring collaboration efficiency.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate whether LLM-based agents answer these questions correctly, human annotators were hired to provide subjective judgment based on fully observable interaction and communication history.
answer_4.guideline: Specifically, the following standard are considered: 1) if the target agent is present in the current room and observes the consequence, 2) if the target agent has been to this room before, 3) if the consequence has been communicated to the target agent.
